Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?

Yes. A damaged item is handled differently from a standard return.

For live plants:

We do not accept returns on live plants.
If a plant arrives with a concern, we ask you to contact us as soon as possible with photos so our team can review the plant’s condition.
Roses are covered by a one-year guarantee, perennials by a 90-day guarantee, and bulbs by a failure-to-bloom guarantee.

For non-plant items:

Standard returns are for unused items within 30 days of delivery.
Return shipping is the customer’s responsibility.
If a non-plant item arrives damaged or has an issue, our team reviews that separately rather than treating it like a standard return.

You can see the full policy here: Our Guarantee

turns.replyText:
Will I get a replacement or a refund?

I completely understand why you want to know this before going any further.

We handle damaged items through our warranty review, rather than automatic replacements or refunds.

• For plants and most garden products, our garden advisors first review your photos and order details.
• If they approve a warranty claim, they issue store credit for the plant or item amount, not a refund to the original payment method and not an automatic replacement.
• You can then use that store credit to order a replacement or anything else on our site (excluding subscriptions).

I am not able to say yet what the outcome will be for your specific order, because that decision is made by our garden advisors after they review your information.

Do I have to pay anything to return the damaged item?

Not usually. Damaged items are handled differently from a standard return, so please do not send anything back unless our team asks you to.

Here’s how it works:

Live plants are not returned.
If a plant or item arrived with damage, our team reviews the photos and order details first.
If it is a standard non-plant return for an unused item, return shipping is the customer’s responsibility.

So if your item arrived damaged, the next step is to send your photos and order details here in chat, and our team will let you know if anything needs to be returned. If you have not sent them yet, please share your full name, email, order number, item name, and photos of the item and box.
